status_of_evidence: SECOND-GENERATION AND WEAKER THAN THE FROZEN THIRTY. Those were authored on the corpus side against a reference checker before the implementation existed. These were authored by the integrator AFTER the defects they cover were known, so they cannot show the implementation was right -- only that a defect found once cannot return unnoticed. Never cite FX2 as external validation.

extends.relationship: ADDITIVE. The frozen thirty are not modified, renumbered or restated. FX2 ids are prefixed FX2- so no id can collide.

validation.strict_json: Emitted with allow_nan=False and re-read by an independent parser (Ruby JSON). An earlier build embedded a NaN literal, which RFC 8259 does not permit and which made the whole file unreadable to Ruby; the NaN case is now carried as a `materialise` instruction.
validation.json_schema: 38/40 validate against schemas/semantic_case_v2.schema.json. Two MAL fixtures are deliberately schema-invalid. A third, FX2-MAL-UNHASHABLE-REFUSE, is SCHEMA-VALID AND SEMANTICALLY MALFORMED -- the schema types obligations_created as `array` with no item constraint -- and is kept for exactly that contrast: passing the published schema is not the same as being a well-formed transition.
validation.against_production_hml: 40/40 match the hand-written expectations, verified by tests/semantic_state/test_fx2_suite.py in the HML repository.

mutation_checked.import type guards removed: the runner raises, so the MAL family detects it
mutation_checked.null-conclusion guard removed: 0 fail -- SEMANTICALLY EQUIVALENT for the verdict, because a non-null published proposition makes the mismatch check catch a null conclusion anyway. Classified rather than papered over with a manufactured fixture; the guard exists for its DIAGNOSTIC, which the HML-side unit test pins.

known_limitations: Authored by the integrator after the defects were known. Cannot demonstrate the implementation was correct; only that a known defect cannot silently return.

13 of 40 fixtures DIVERGE from the frozen reference checker, each with a recorded reason. Those encode deliberate production strictness (frame condition over candidates/branches/obligations, scope containment, trust modes) and are NOT evidence of agreement with an external oracle.

The two AMPS-derived fixtures rest on a COMMUNITY MIRROR of AMPS-Khan, traced one hop to HuggingFace XinyaoHu/AMPS_khan and not verified against Hendrycks' official release. The mathematical pattern is independently checkable; the attribution is not.

The frozen semantic_case schema requires `domain` on every claim, so 'this claim carries no domain' is not expressible there. FX2 defines its own claim schema with `domain` optional, because D-048 made that absence semantically meaningful.
